title: platform-standup-2026-04-07
content:
Platform standup notes - 2026-04-07
Attendees: Jordan Lee (owner), Priya Desai, Marco Alvarez, Hannah Park, Samir Gupta

Today TLDR:
- Control plane: rolling config rollout for route-prioritization continues; small regression found in v1.3.2 -> rollback partial canary
- Routing: path-based routing tests green for low-latency tier; need to increase weight for EU region
- Auth: short outage on token refresh path overnight - root cause is cache eviction race in auth-cache service
- Quotas: quota accounting fix deployed to staging; still seeing delayed counters for bursty workloads

Updates
1) Control plane
- Priya finished the canary rollout of route-priority config. Observed increased tail latency on a small subset (~0.7% requests) when using kernel optimization A. Reverted canary to previous config and opened PLAT-412 (linked).
- Action: Priya to instrument more granular traces and add a mitigation flag to allow per-tenant fallback. ETA: 2026-04-09.
- Note: work on config-schema v2 is ongoing; need to update Console UI to surface per-route override docs (Marco).

2) Routing
- Marco: path-based routing for low-latency tier passed integration tests. Need to ramp EU weight from 10% -> 35% to reduce US egress on busy routes. Scheduling window: 2026-04-08 02:00-04:00 UTC.
- Identified a TTL edge-case in dynamic pool selection when capacity falls below threshold; ticket created (JIRA-PLAT-421).

3) Auth
- Hannah: Token refresh endpoint had increased 500s between 01:15-01:45 UTC due to auth-cache eviction race after recent memcache client upgrade.
- Mitigation applied: short-term pinning of cache client version and extended TTL from 60s -> 120s. Monitoring added.
- Action: Hannah to coordinate with infra for a robust fix (atomic refresh + jitter). ETA: 2026-04-10.

4) Quotas
- Samir: Deployed quota-accounting patch to staging (PR #789). Counters now consistent for steady state but show ~2s lag under burst. Investigating batching window.
- Action: experiment with faster flush threshold and histogram-based backpressure. Samir to run load tests on 2026-04-08.

Blockers
- Cannot fully re-run control-plane canary until we add mitigations for kernel optimization regression (blocking route-priority rollout).
- Token refresh race needs infra coordination; blocked on memcache cluster maintenance schedule.

Decisions
- Rollback canary for route-prioritization until further traces obtained.
- Ramp EU routing weight during off-peak window; monitor latencies and error rates closely.

Action items (owners)
- Priya: add per-tenant fallback flag + tracing (ETA 2026-04-09)
- Marco: Console UI doc updates + schedule EU ramp (ETA 2026-04-08)
- Hannah: implement atomic token refresh fix plan + memcache maintenance coordination (ETA 2026-04-10)
- Samir: run quota flush tuning load tests (2026-04-08) and report results

Notes / Misc
- Reminder: Demo for Dedicated routing improvements scheduled for 2026-04-14 with product.
- Follow-up: create post-mortem if token refresh 500s reoccur; preliminary incident doc started in Confluence (linked).

Next standup: 2026-04-08
